links.comparator_used: AI alone (also compared with radiologist manual reading alone)
links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy (AUC) and number of diagnostic errors for PE detection on CTPA
links.effect: Combined manual + AI AUC 0.928-0.934 vs AI alone 0.807-0.810 (manual alone 0.888-0.914); diagnostic errors 7 with combined vs 43 for AI alone (29 for manual alone)
links.tradeoff: Combined reading took longer than AI alone (2.61 ± 0.69 min vs 0.19 ± 0.02 min), though it was shorter than manual reading alone (5.26 ± 0.94 min).
links.quote: The combined approach significantly reduced diagnostic errors to 7 cases compared to 43 for AI alone and 29 for manual reading alone.
